text.title: Express pilot in Moscow: stakeholders, July 2026
text.keep_satisfied: head of finance: approves the budget, sees little of daily work
text.manage_closely: ops director: runs couriers; reviews the pilot every week
text.monitor: local media: low impact; coverage checked monthly
text.keep_informed: couriers: routes change; told by push and at the weekly meeting
text.decision: ops director decides; finance signs off the budget
text.result: pilot routes approved 1 July; courier churn checked after 6 weeks
